verdict.rationale: Summer Engine is a 2D/3D game engine, so importing standard interchange formats is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence never mentions importing glTF, FBX, USD, or any external asset format. The only asset-related claim describes a library of ready-made models and textures, which is an adjacent feature and is not credited here.

support.subject: As a technical artist, standard interchange formats — glTF, FBX, USD — import cleanly
